page.layout: One page of a table in three columns (Cap., Verf., Lo...), the right column cut off at the edge of the scan.; One page of an index table in four columns with a heading across the top. At the left edge a cut-off column of numbers. Then the columns Th., Cap., Vers. and Loc., with a vertical rule after Th. Small stubs of a further column appear at the right edge.; One page of a table in four columns (Th., Cap., Verf., Loc., Th.), with a large letter X above the table.
page.notes: The right-hand column of the table is cut off at the edge of the scan, so its numbers are incomplete. Some Cap. numbers (the 11. at the top of the second group and the 17. near the foot) are doubtful and may be misread. Left-edge column and right-edge stubs are cut off by the scan edge; only the visible digits are given, and the stub rows are approximate. The heading is cut at the right, reading "I N D E" as far as visible. Some digits at the right edge are unreadable and omitted. Faint ghosted print of the page behind the table is not transcribed. The first row's Verf. "17,&c." and the 37. and 29. rows carry "&c." set on separate lines; placed as printed. Some digits in the faint Verf. column are uncertain, notably "7" in row 49 and "3" in row 26.
